city.description: Nearest city to the dam as published; empty when the source records none.
city.title: Nearest City

condition_assessment.description: Condition assessment as published in the source (Satisfactory / Fair / Poor / Unsatisfactory / Not Rated / Not Available), when present.
condition_assessment.title: Condition Assessment

condition_assessment_date.description: Date of the published condition assessment, YYYY-MM-DD, when present.
condition_assessment_date.title: Condition Assessment Date

congressional_district.description: Congressional district description as published in the source.
congressional_district.title: Congressional District

county.description: County (parish) where the dam is located, as published.
county.title: County

dam_height_ft.description: Dam height in feet as published, when present.
dam_height_ft.title: Dam Height (ft)

dam_length_ft.description: Length of the dam crest in feet as published, when present.
dam_length_ft.title: Dam Length (ft)

dam_name.description: Name of the dam as published in the National Inventory of Dams (NID).
dam_name.title: Dam Name

dam_types.description: All construction types recorded for the dam, separated by '; ', as published.
dam_types.title: Dam Types

data_updated.description: Date the source record was last updated by its reporting agency, YYYY-MM-DD.
data_updated.title: Data Updated

distance_to_city_mi.description: Distance in miles from the dam to the nearest city, when the source records a city.
distance_to_city_mi.title: Distance to City (mi)

drainage_area_sq_mi.description: Drainage area in square miles as published, when present.
drainage_area_sq_mi.title: Drainage Area (sq mi)

eap_last_revision_date.description: Date of the last Emergency Action Plan revision, YYYY-MM-DD, when present.
eap_last_revision_date.title: EAP Last Revision Date

eap_status.description: Emergency Action Plan status as published (Yes / No / Not Required). Only the status is published; no plan document or contents are included.
eap_status.title: EAP Status

federal_regulated.description: Whether the dam is regulated by a federal agency (Yes / No), as published.
federal_regulated.title: Federal Regulated

hazard_potential_class.description: Hazard potential classification published in the source (High / Significant / Low / Undetermined). It classifies the consequences if the dam failed — loss of life and damage downstream — and is NOT a statement about the dam's condition.
hazard_potential_class.title: Hazard Potential Class

hydraulic_height_ft.description: Hydraulic height in feet as published, when present.
hydraulic_height_ft.title: Hydraulic Height (ft)

inspection_frequency_years.description: Published inspection frequency in years, when present.
inspection_frequency_years.title: Inspection Frequency (years)

last_inspection_date.description: Most recent inspection date recorded in the source, YYYY-MM-DD, when present.
last_inspection_date.title: Last Inspection Date

latitude.description: Latitude of the dam in decimal degrees (NAD83), when provided by the source.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: Longitude of the dam in decimal degrees (NAD83), when provided by the source.
longitude.title: Longitude

max_discharge_cfs.description: Maximum discharge in cubic feet per second as published, when present.
max_discharge_cfs.title: Max Discharge (cfs)

max_storage_acre_ft.description: Maximum storage capacity in acre-feet as published, when present.
max_storage_acre_ft.title: Max Storage (acre-ft)

nid_height_ft.description: General dam height used by the NID in feet (the accepted maximum of the published heights), when present.
nid_height_ft.title: NID Height (ft)

nid_id.description: National Inventory of Dams identification number assigned by USACE; stable across editions.
nid_id.title: NID ID

normal_storage_acre_ft.description: Normal storage capacity in acre-feet as published, when present.
normal_storage_acre_ft.title: Normal Storage (acre-ft)

operational_status.description: Operational status as published in the source, when present.
operational_status.title: Operational Status

owner_types.description: All owner types recorded for the dam, separated by '; ', as published.
owner_types.title: Owner Types

primary_dam_type.description: Primary construction type of the dam as published (e.g. Earth, Gravity, Rockfill).
primary_dam_type.title: Primary Dam Type

primary_owner_type.description: Primary owner type as published (Federal / State / Local Government / Public Utility / Private / Tribal Government / Not Listed). Owner names are never output.
primary_owner_type.title: Primary Owner Type

primary_purpose.description: Primary purpose of the dam as published (e.g. Flood Control, Water Supply, Hydroelectric, Recreation).
primary_purpose.title: Primary Purpose

purposes.description: All purposes recorded for the dam, separated by '; ', as published.
purposes.title: Purposes

river_name.description: River or stream the dam impounds, as published.
river_name.title: River

scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this Actor retrieved the record (ISO 8601).
scraped_at.title: Retrieved At

source_agency.description: Agency that supplied the record to the NID, as published.
source_agency.title: Source Agency

source_endpoint.description: Official USACE NID national GeoPackage file the record was retrieved from.
source_endpoint.title: Source Endpoint

spillway_type.description: Spillway type as published (e.g. Controlled, Uncontrolled), when present.
spillway_type.title: Spillway Type

state.description: Two-letter state / territory code of the dam's location (NID stateKey).
state.title: State Code

state_name.description: State / territory name as published in the source.
state_name.title: State Name

state_regulated.description: Whether the dam is regulated by the state (Yes / No), as published.
state_regulated.title: State Regulated

state_regulatory_agency.description: State agency regulating the dam, when published.
state_regulatory_agency.title: State Regulatory Agency

structural_height_ft.description: Structural height in feet as published, when present.
structural_height_ft.title: Structural Height (ft)

surface_area_acres.description: Reservoir surface area in acres as published, when present.
surface_area_acres.title: Surface Area (acres)

year_completed.description: Year the dam's construction was completed, when published.
year_completed.title: Year Completed

zip_code.description: ZIP code of the dam's location as published.
zip_code.title: ZIP Code
